authority: Gate00/user; each specialist Gate owns only commissioned content
mission: A reusable, fast, regression-resistant software-mastery and automation pipeline so Gates 01–12 directly execute user's commissioned requests using Koikatsu, Blender, Gaea, Unreal and future software. Disposable reference characters are benchmarks, not products.

startup_contract.method: Call mastery_preflight.ensure_master() during dispatcher validation and pipeline validation before any effects
mandatory: Load this ledger before selecting a tool or authoring a recipe
Retrieve existing proven route/asset/recipe rather than discover again
Match task to owning Gate and user quality threshold
Apply relevant lessons and regression checks before execution
Preserve sources, report actual native/effective/visual parity separately
startup_contract.gate03_to_gate11: Knowledge applies to all Gates; full native gatectl dispatch routes for Gates03–08,10,11 have NOT been built. Do not falsely claim otherwise.

gates.Gate01: Characters/models: reference-to-neutral-KK recipe; silhouette/face/body first; native materials/accessories/wardrobe; KKBP -> Blender -> Gate12
gates.Gate02: Worlds/environments/architecture: Gaea graph and terrain, Blender real geometry, Gate12 world integration
gates.Gate03: Music/score: authored compositions, MIDI, stems, lossless rendered files, adaptive parameters; Gate12 playback
gates.Gate04: Combat/stats/skills: typed mechanical data and kits; Gate12 runtime
gates.Gate05: Narrative/lore/quests: branching authored text/graphs and causality; Gate11 registry Gate12 quest integration
gates.Gate06: NPCs/factions/civilizations: simulation schemas and identities, Gate12 persistence
gates.Gate07: Items/equipment/economy: typed items and loot/balance data, Gate11 registry Gate12 integration
gates.Gate08: Encounters/dungeons/events: persistent encounter and boss data, Gate12 execution
gates.Gate09: Animation/VFX/cinematics/SFX/voice: source clips, rigged movements, editable authored motions; Gate12 native movement and retarget
gates.Gate10: UI/UX/visual assets: approved designs and sources; Gate12 UI integration
gates.Gate11: Master registry and integration: read-only Registry v2 authority; acceptance discipline
gates.Gate12: UE5.8.3 native authoring, Android integration, retarget/material fidelity, tests; do not mutate frozen Foundation

rules.requirement: All character images in current software-mastery series are disposable capability benchmarks, NOT commissioned canonical characters. Optimize reusable automations, execution speed, user-defined tolerances, and learning.
rules.procedure: At task start classify evaluation versus production; leave Gate00/11 canonical assets untouched. User decides when a software study is complete.
rules.evidence: Confirmed instruction 2026-10-16

rules.requirement: Every user correction and repeatable discovery must become an explicit executable procedure, source code or parameter map, and a regression check before moving to the next test.
rules.procedure: Read knowledge manifest at start, reuse proven technique without rediscovery; log new finding plus evidence and add regression coverage.
rules.evidence: Explicit user requirement 2026-10-16

rules.requirement: Use previously indexed APIs; prioritize batched direct native edits, cached asset lookup and short visual evaluation. Do not perform idle exploratory operations, unnecessary restarts, screenshots or image transfers.
rules.procedure: Plan one pass: parse desired traits, shortlist indexed assets, build with native calls, evaluate, repair only large differences. Record timed stages; stop at user-sufficient quality.
rules.evidence: SM01 subsecond calls; Test3 25-31s batches; user's manual benchmark approximately 5min

rules.requirement: Default Chika Haruno must NOT be the implicit creative template; neutralize and explicitly author required face/body/hair/makeup/clothing/accessory fields.
rules.procedure: Use explicit neutral recipe and clean active coordinate. Do not hide unused parts as substitute for removal. Native coordinate tests must show intended saved IDs.
rules.evidence: User correction 2026-10-16

rules.requirement: CLOTHED, UNDERWEAR and NUDE are actual separate character appearance/source configurations for Gate01; privacy/SFW representation never mutates real wardrobe or ownership.
rules.procedure: Build and validate each actual clothing state with material, meshes and saved coordinate; no forced modesty or synthetic hiding. Gate00/Gate11 approve semantics.
rules.evidence: Gate00 adult-scope directive; user 2026-10-16

rules.requirement: Use installed assets first (27,849 indexed SM01 items); candidate matches by silhouettes and components; test potentially useful existing assets in small fast batches, never blindly start modeling.
rules.procedure: Rank front/back/side hair, top, sleeves, socks, accessories separately; match IDs/category/GUID and visually compare. No multiminute inventory rediscovery.
rules.evidence: Test2 user improved using SAME selected setup; Test3 oversize tee found after wrong shirt-dress

rules.requirement: Face, eye shape/color, mature/soft expression, body silhouette and BREAST/BUST SIZE must be explicit first-class targets, not gloss or afterthoughts.
rules.procedure: Apply semantic slider map; compare proportions before clothes. Test3 drastically underestimated bust and user fixed; do not silently use default or assume clothes imply anatomy.
rules.evidence: User test2 face6/body11 differences; Test3 user correction bust

rules.requirement: Koikatsu UI exposes 47 body and 52 face named sliders, but prior runtime wrapper only accepted 44 body and 52 face indices. Wrapper 0..1 range is not evidence of all game's allowed UI ranges.
rules.procedure: Use kk_semantic_slider_catalog.json, verify actual native index/value per operation. Do not clamp arbitrary larger values or claim full capability from wrapper limits. Treat extra controls as a gap.
rules.evidence: Test3 wrapper rejected body indices >=44 and >1; user notes additional control

rules.requirement: Complex hair uses front/back/side plus attached hair components; all translations/rotations/scales and anchor bones are available. Do not leave hair floating.
rules.procedure: Select layered pieces before custom mesh; place by X/Y/Z, rotation, scale; compare from front/side. Transform-first, shader-color-last if renderer recreates.
rules.evidence: Test2 user manually corrected; Test3 thick braid misplaced then recolored

rules.requirement: Support six native vector fields pos,rot,scale,pos2,rot2,scale2; scale 1=100%, allow 360-degree rotations and 0.01 secondary scale, correct parent bones.
rules.procedure: Use SM01Placement.cs and native card readback, including both coordinate correction sets. Skip no-op setters. Use direct native item IDs or resolved mod GUIDs.
rules.evidence: User Test2 ears position .6,-2.4,-1.7 rotation25,5,359 scale .83,.77,1.75 secondary .84,1.4,1

rules.requirement: Appearance edits must SURVIVE later asset replacement, accessory transforms, save and export: no white/grey braid, no navy sleeve regression.
rules.procedure: Order geometry/asset/pose mutations first; recolor palette and shader _Color/_Color2/_Color3/_ShadowColor/_LineColor LAST; compare expected palette in final render and native saved state.
rules.evidence: Test3 braid turned white then grey after transform, navy returned; user explicitly flags regression

rules.requirement: Native successful setter != saved character; call AssignCoordinate(currentType, nowCoordinate) before SaveCharaFile; independently reload and compare all 9 clothing IDs, 20 accessory identity/parent plus two correction matrices.
rules.procedure: Use corrected SM01RuntimeController source; reject 'card saved' receipts lacking native_coordinate_roundtrip PASS and fresh visual review.
rules.evidence: Test2 user's saved had 6 accessories; automated card 0. Test3 new save 9/9+20/20 roundtrip PASS

rules.requirement: Blush/makeup is reference-dependent, never inherited. Eye color AND iris/eyeshadow asset ID must be authored, not just an RGB change.
rules.procedure: Use native set_face_makeup to clear cheeks where absent; set_iris_asset, set_eye_iris, eye shapes, shadow and expression; inspect saved card.
rules.evidence: Test2 cheek ID0 alpha0; iris10->6 and eyeshadow2->9; Test3 blue iris

rules.requirement: Scene-dependent wetness, droplets, temporary lighting or pose is not inherent character design. Do not spend production time implementing it in reusable character assets unless user requests that state.
rules.procedure: Ignore contextual wet effect by default; prioritize appearance anchors, clothes silhouette, hair and proportions. Optional world/scene variants are separate.
rules.evidence: Test3 user explicit correction

rules.requirement: Use KK for nearly all available design; Blender only for unmatched geometry, source rig or real material polish. Correct exporter dependency profile and verify actual PMX output.
rules.procedure: KKBP 5.6 in isolated sandbox, plugins KK_Accessory_States and KK_Pushup; export, require source PMX meshes+textures; import editable armatures, shape keys; diagnose parity not just file existence.
rules.evidence: Test3 KKBP PMX exported, Blender import 2 armatures 454 shapekeys 237845 vertices

rules.requirement: No replacement with flat Blender shader masks. Blender import with zero images is NOT polished render; KKBP exports CM/DM/MT/NMP etc textures which must be mapped to material inputs.
rules.procedure: Verify imported image count >0, diffuse/albedo texture present on visible face/hair/shirt materials, UVs, transparency, normals, contact/reference renders, shape key/rig preservation. Avoid using *_DM (normal-like data) as base color.
rules.evidence: Test3 original MMD shader group had 0 loaded images while KKBP export textures existed. Flat underwhelming preview was not accepted.

rules.requirement: Success means requested capability and acceptable result, NOT just tools called, files present, render produced or API 200. User tolerates non-pixel-exact likeness in capability tests and can declare a benchmark sufficiently assessed.
rules.procedure: Stage native validity separately from appearance quality; stop once user-defined threshold attained. Never over-polish disposable test or claim canonical acceptance.
rules.evidence: User Test3 says present version good enough despite bust corrections; no approval for Test1/2 as faithful characters

rules.requirement: Master branch software/mastery-integrated only; private QA dirs; never alter frozen foundation/production Gate branches or original Steam install. Do not close user's apps or rebuild without request.
rules.procedure: Keep original sources and user cards hash-preserved, QA unique IDs. Avoid giant repeated PMX/blend intermediate copies, reclaim only clearly disposable test outputs with scoped consent.
rules.evidence: User directives; Test3 ~67.85MB redundant files cleaned; worktree frozen foundation

rules.requirement: Use actual high resolution reference if already accessible; viewer should remain persistent with crops/zoom; do not waste minutes transferring to Windows via text/base64 or use 144p substitutes.
rules.procedure: Prefer mounted original asset or already-PC image; only use overlay when image bytes genuinely available; if unavailable do not invent image or present 144p as full source. Overlay never masks Maker controls.
rules.evidence: Test1+2 low-res transfer failures; overlay code exists, Test2 full-res PC transfer NOT verified

rules.requirement: Test1 silver-haired lilac-eyed high collar woman failed: default face, weak hair layering, wrong clothing, no faithful editable 3D acceptance.
rules.procedure: Do not treat failure as approved; apply lessons to asset matching, face/body and card save. Avoid continuing old disposable card.
rules.evidence: Test1 user and assistant visual feedback

rules.requirement: Test2 ivory bunny user card demonstrates existing setup could deliver better via transforms/colors/proportions/fishnets; reference has large bust/hair, amber eyes and white outfit.
rules.procedure: Compare user card native values rather than assume better assets. User card 6 accessories, automated saved card 0 due AssignCoordinate bug; replay both transform matrices.
rules.evidence: TEST02_CARD_LEARNING_20261016.md and TEST02_USER_VS_AUTOMATION_DIFF_20261016.json

rules.requirement: Test3 orange braided blue-eyed woman in white tee and thigh-highs: user's verdict 'current version good enough' for capability assessment, but missed bust size significantly; wetness unnecessary.
rules.procedure: Record benchmark as sufficiently assessed, not accurate production character. Retain native morph correction and color override order, discard extra texture polishing unless needed for pipeline.
rules.evidence: User 2026-10-16; saved Test3 native roundtrip PASS

rules.requirement: Gaea 2.3.1 has a verified native project/build, 16-bit terrain/tiled export and 4 UE StaticMeshes; arbitrary Gaea graph GUI automation and UE native Landscape/World Partition not proven.
rules.procedure: Use installed nodes/doctor UTF-8 env and checked layouts; preserve graph source and height units; distinguish StaticMesh terrain from Landscape acceptance.
rules.evidence: Gaea VALIDATION reports and UE QA fixture

rules.requirement: Native animation evidence includes skeletal Actions/export and sample motion, but facial expression/locomotion with foot slide, X/Y travel facing, natural transitions, sustained swim and flight remain inadequate.
rules.procedure: Check actual authored clips before procedural; per-skeleton rig anatomy and genuine bone deltas, IK foot contacts, root travel, loop sustain, retarget, Android native observation.
rules.evidence: Gate09/12 physical quality issue report

rules.requirement: Unreal 5.8.3 isolated Blueprint native compile passed, some PCG/material/Sequencer/StaticMesh fixtures exist, but gameplay/Android visual parity, emitter functionality, Landscape and full retarget not verified.
rules.procedure: Require fresh native receipts, saved/reloaded assets, real scene visual QA, on-device Android test, asset ID/Registry compliance; never equate importer return code with pass.
rules.evidence: Blueprint compile native proof; Gate12 QA limitations

rules.requirement: Software mastery is shared infrastructure; Gates 01-12 remain owners of their production source and must use the pipeline without treating software tests as approval.
rules.procedure: Gate00 creative authority; Gate11 Registry2 intake; Gate12 UE runtime; share capabilities through manifest/handoff; do not create canonical assets uncommissioned.
rules.evidence: Original Gate commission scopes

rules.requirement: A newly edited character form or wardrobe card may update coordinate zero while retaining six previous form presets; never auto-promote untouched inherited presets as accepted states.
rules.procedure: Before staging any KK form or CLOTHED/UNDERWEAR/NUDE cards, run coordinate_inheritance_guard.py with the approved base and candidate card; review changed coordinate indices, explicitly map the intended saved state, and perform native AssignCoordinate SaveCharaFile reload validation for chosen state. Do not silently use unchanged presets as Alter source.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 three genuine Luminous V3-to-Alter candidate native card diffs: only coordinate index 0 changed, indices 1 to 6 retain former base clothing presets; source SHA and copies staged read-only.
rules.regression_test: mastery_regression_tests coordinate_inheritance_guard fixture: only coordinate 0 changed returns REVIEW_INHERITED_COORDINATES, baseline matching indices 1..6, no_auto_promotion true; all seven changed does not falsely report inherited presets.

rules.requirement: When a user overwrites an already ingested native character card, hash the current original again and preserve it as a new immutable source revision; never overwrite previous staged copies or silently keep the previous card active.
rules.procedure: Run native_kk_card_diff_v1.py against the original prior intake and overwritten live source, then intake_native_kk_card.py to a unique revision-tagged output directory. Rehash copied bytes, update authoritative handoff source manifest/current SHA and retain superseded source as audit-only. Keep user-authored visual edits unchanged and do not reset extras/materials.
rules.evidence: Luminous Alter user overwrite verified 2026-10-16, previous hash fccab219... preserved, new current hash 15d51bce... captured; one accessory slot and MaterialEditor payload changed.
rules.regression_test: mastery_regression_tests should assert two separate immutable intake directories retain different source hashes and refuse overwrites of either previously captured revision.

rules.requirement: Reject character export visual acceptance when original KKBP normal-map assets or toon material channels disappear during Blender GLB FBX or Unreal translation. Distinguish true model scaling from material or camera changes.
rules.procedure: Read hash-locked native source and KKBP source texture inventories. Audit target GLB PBR normalTexture alpha and baseColor bindings using p0_glb_shader_audit.py or the reusable native_3d_material_scale_guard.py. Compare source PMX and GLB bounding dimensions along XYZ with relative tolerance, then separately measure actual Unreal asset and rendered actor size. Never declare acceptance from equal mesh vertex counts, generic import success, or camera-unmatched images.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 Luminous V3 CLOTHED 299 raw KKBP source PNGs with 29 NMP-named maps, Blender imported 126 images and 71 materials, but final GLB has 40 baseColor images, 45 materials, zero normalTexture bindings, 41 blend alpha materials. PMX outfit-to-GLB bounds match 1.2383x1.5217x0.6701. Gate11 visual acceptance not granted.
rules.regression_test: mastery_regression_tests asserts 29 source normals with 0 target normal bindings returns P0_HOLD_MATERIAL_PARITY even when PMX-to-GLB scale is exact; change in X/Y/Z bounds triggers separate scale failure; visual_fidelity_accepted always false absent render review.

rules.requirement: Measure actual nonzero morph-target vertex displacement at each export boundary, not only shape-key names or import thresholds.
rules.procedure: For each exact source state and hashed GLB parse dense and sparse POSITION accessors, compare mesh names, exact target names and indices, nonzero vertex counts and max displacement; check matched-state Blender/GLB; fail on lost effective morphs and report Unreal stage separately.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 P0_BLEND_SOURCE_EFFECTIVE_MORPHS all states and P0_GLB_EFFECTIVE_SPARSE_MORPH_DELTAS matched effective 247 CLOTHED 242 UNDERWEAR 242 NUDE with no missing morphs and median maximum delta ratio 1.0.
rules.regression_test: p0_targeted_regressions.py requires exact effective counts and names index stability across all three states.

rules.requirement: Opaque Unreal upper-eyeline shader is incompatible with original GLB BLEND and embedded partial-alpha gradient; preserve authentic material opacity and source texture channels.
rules.procedure: Inspect source exported alpha atlases and decoded embedded GLB image; derive per-material Unreal Translucent source contract and validate actual opacity render under matched camera/light, retaining separate eye/eyeline/hair materials and normals.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 P0_NATIVE_GLB_EYELINE_ALPHA_AUDIT and EMBEDDED_COMPARISON: upper eyeline BLEND for all three states; partial-alpha embedded fraction 0.15737 CLOTHED and 0.178778 UNDERWEAR NUDE; native MT_CT upper atlas has gradient.
rules.regression_test: p0_targeted_regressions.py fails if source eye gradient absent or BLEND replaced with OPAQUE and requires Gate12 unresolved native status.

rules.requirement: A compiled Unity assembled-renderer capture prototype is not a verified native capture; never touch the original Steam Koikatsu process or cards to bypass a blocked sandbox test.
rules.procedure: Validate source SHA and immutable protected Party card clone, original sandbox DLL backup and live source resolvers; only run separate isolated sandbox when no conflicting user Koikatsu session exists; restore runtime in finally and require real measured SkinnedMeshRenderer mesh/bone/morph/material readbacks for both Base and Alter.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 p0_protected_native_live_try.ps1 aborted before deployment because original Steam Koikatsu Party PID 17728 was running; sandbox runtime original hash verified; no native assembled renderer capture accepted.
rules.regression_test: p0_targeted_regressions.py asserts restored sandbox DLL and source card hashes; runtime acceptance remains blocked until authentic clone capture receipts.

rules.requirement: An actually reimported GLB must preserve effective shape-key deltas, not just stored sparse accessors; distinguish source-level dummy morph names from effective face and body deformers.
rules.procedure: On each matching original CLOTHED UNDERWEAR NUDE source GLB, run clean Blender 5.2.2 GLTF import, inspect actual keyblocks and measure nonzero vertex deltas versus Basis; compare exact source counts and target name/index mapping and require downstream Gate12 Unreal evidence separately.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 P0_BLENDER_GLB_REIMPORT_EFFECTIVE_MORPHS.json: effective nonzero Blender keyblocks after fresh GLB import exactly 247 CLOTHED 242 UNDERWEAR 242 NUDE; source Blender 247/242/242, GLB accessor decoded 247/242/242.
rules.regression_test: p0_targeted_regressions.py clean_blender_import_effective CLOTHED UNDERWEAR NUDE require exact effective counts matching source and decoded GLB.

rules.requirement: GLB joint count equality never proves shared animation compatibility; compare path-local and global rest, inverse bind matrices, per-joint real skin weights, original source hashes and time-varying motion on actual character meshes.
rules.procedure: Run Gate09 Scripts/Gate09/audit_luminous_rig.py against immutable original three BLENDER_FRESH GLBs, save reports to protected local location, classify only the terminal bone segment, run bake_existing_bvh_motion.py on source CMU BVH and real GLB, verify deforming skin samples and imported FBX action, perform three-angle Blender QA; accept visuals, foot contacts and runtime separately.
rules.evidence: Gate09 2026-10-16 actual hashes c1efbc9d/bdf8a59f/a5800ca3, 975 joints each, 782 shared paths, weighted 324/297/295, BVH 144_20 retarget mapped 22 bones with 0.113m evaluated vertex motion, genuine .blend/FBX reimport, 3 PNG captures, 10/10 Gate09 source QA tests.
rules.regression_test: Gate09 Scripts/Gate09/test_gate09_source_qa.py enforces three real GLB hashes, joint and weight counts, 782 shared paths with fail-closed compatibility, 22 retargeted bones, actual skin displacement, artifact hashes, three captures and animation-only FBX native reload; Gate09 visual/Unreal acceptance stays false.

rules.requirement: Test4 assessed at 6.7/10 by user: more recognizable than past benchmarks but only barely average; actual reference wears a mostly BLACK fitted Jeanne-Alter-like military commander uniform. Match color dominance, silhouette, face/body size, hair, engraved crest and placements; don't just match franchise and loosely similar armor.
rules.procedure: Before modeling, extract source image's prioritized visible anchors and color dominance, rank installed clothing by silhouette and colors, stage alternate matching candidates, then evaluate front/face/hair/cape and corrected XYZ/scale together. Correct the largest visible deviations quickly; stop at user's benchmark sufficiency. Reference-specific outfit color dominance is a required visual gate.
rules.evidence: User feedback 2026-10-17: Test4 6.7/10, uniform black commander rather than generic knight; body, hair, size and accessory placement require improvement; stops Test4 and transitions to harder Test5.
rules.regression_test: TEST04_LESSONS_ONE_SESSION_GATE01_20261017.md test04 stage identity and color dominance; reject claims of full fidelity or approved art at 6.7/10.

rules.requirement: Avoid serial close-reopen cycles per asset or mod during character benchmark. Stage all plausibly relevant indexed mod dependencies before ONE planned sandbox Maker launch; keep full original catalog searchable but never blindly copy all 38GB into RAM.
rules.procedure: Run kk_one_session.py plan using multiple reference-feature terms and pinned GUIDs, enforce package budget, then kk_one_session.py stage exactly once while NO Koikatsu game process is active. Run one Maker session; do not change the selected-mod folder mid-run and assume Unity hotloads. If a candidate is absent, select already loaded alternatives or defer it until next planned cold launch.
rules.evidence: User 2026-10-17 Test4: approximately 25 minutes elapsed with only about 1 minute actual modifications (4 percent by user estimate), repeated restarts added major delay; current selective sandbox has fully indexed assets but only a subset staged.
rules.regression_test: test_kk_one_session.py catalog_plan, disk cap, missing mandatory GUID and no restart guard; do not claim full live speed proof before Test5.

rules.requirement: Minimize dead time: continuous Koikatsu edits in one persistent Python/native session, not separate script startup, arbitrary inspections or prolonged planning for each click. Track true end-to-end wall time vs active modification time.
rules.procedure: Use kk_one_session.py batch with validated operation recipe and direct in-process SM01 client.submit; deduplicate adjacent identical ops, stop immediately on native failure, collect per-operation durations, and never auto-start/restart game. Measure image intake/catalog/stage/start/modify/visual checkpoints separately on subsequent real benchmark; use expected durations as targets not established achievements.
rules.evidence: User 2026-10-17 Test4 evaluation reports 25 minutes and approximately 1 minute genuine editing; 2026-10-17 new mock transport/regression suite 13/13 demonstrates single-process API batching and timing, real live speed improvement not tested.
rules.regression_test: test_kk_one_session.py validates persistent batch with fake submit, saved telemetry, native morph TSV and no unexpected save; require live latency measurement and restart count on Test5.
